summary.cycles_note: integral of the record rates over time (gaps filled from neighbours)
summary.rate_note: early/late: median of the records' zero-crossing rates of the core coordinate over the first/last 10% of records
summary.tail_fit_rate_source: rate measured over the fit interval (median of its records), nearest of 81 bank rates within +-10% of the record rate at the start of the interval (AT BANK EDGE)
